home_subtitle: 第五课 · 宠物大直播
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：全单元回炉——副词构成总表、比较级最高级总表、19 个新词与 9 个短语逐个过；读一场'该不该养狗'的辩论，学找观点和论据。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：独立读宠物俱乐部给新主人的信，课尾压轴：全语法综合、被动与完成时回锅、事实与观点辨析、写作句产出。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：Unit 8 全语法综合（副词构成/位置/比较级/最高级/易混词）、全单元词汇短语复测、辩论体阅读的观点与论据提取、事实与观点辨析（对齐课本阅读题型）。压轴回锅被动语态、现在完成时、unless。

steps.title: 宠物大直播：收官节目
steps.teach_html:
Unit 8 的最后一课，大直播开场！今天我们把整个单元的东西全部回炉：副词的构成、比较级、最高级、19 个新词和 9 个短语，一个都不能少。

节目还有一场重头戏——辩论：到底该不该养狗？两位同学各说各的理。你不但要读懂，还要能找出他们各自的观点和论据，这是课本阅读里的真题型。

steps.title: 回炉一：副词构成总表
steps.teach_html:
快速过一遍构成规则：

① 一般加 -ly：quick → quickly，careful → carefully。
② -y 结尾变 i 加 ly：happy → happily，easy → easily。
③ -le 结尾去 e 加 y：simple → simply，responsible → responsibly。
④ -ll 结尾加 y：full → fully；true 特例：truly。
⑤ 同形不动：fast、early、hard、late；good → well（特殊）。

steps.title: 回炉二：比较级最高级总表
steps.teach_html:
① -ly 副词：more carefully → most carefully。
② 同形副词：faster → fastest，harder → hardest，earlier → earliest。
③ 不规则：well → better → best；badly → worse → worst；little → less → least；much → more → most。

判断口诀：先数对象——两者或 than 用比较级；三者以上或 of all 用最高级；只有一个对象，什么级都不用。

steps.title: 词汇回炉一：狗与主人
steps.teach_html:
faithful 忠实的；responsible 可信任的；awake 醒着；attack（动词）攻击；hold 抱着、拿着；choice 选择；flat 公寓。

造句回炉：A faithful dog is awake early and waits quietly. A responsible owner holds the lead carefully.

steps.title: 词汇回炉二：麻烦与历史
steps.teach_html:
complain 抱怨；litter 垃圾；unlikely 不大可能；relieve 方便、解手；indoors 在室内；advise 建议；cause 引起。

历史组：magical 有魔力的；wealth 财富；queen 女王；servant 仆人；pride 自豪；among 在……中；relationship 关系。

steps.title: 短语回炉：九个全过
steps.teach_html:
grow up 长大；care for 照顾；in short 总之；have no choice but to do 只能……；run free 四处自由走动；lie around 懒散度日；complain about 抱怨（某事）；in addition 除此之外（还）；catch the eye of somebody 引起某人的注意。

这九个短语，直播里会换着花样考你。

steps.title: 辩论读法：观点 + 论据
steps.teach_html:
辩论文章的结构：先亮观点（I think... / In my opinion...），再一条一条给论据。

论据的信号词：First / Firstly 第一，Second / Secondly 第二，In addition 另外，Finally 最后；收尾用 In short。

还要分清：事实 (fact) 是能验证的，如'Dogs have four legs.'；观点 (opinion) 是个人看法，如'Dogs are the best pets.'——课本阅读题就爱考这个。

steps.title: 易混点：最后三个坑
steps.teach_html:
① hardly 不是 hard 的副词升级版，它是“几乎不”：He hardly sleeps.（他几乎不睡。）

② friendly 以 -ly 结尾却是形容词：a friendly dog。

③ 双重比较是大忌：more faster、more better、carefullier 全部不存在。变形之前先分类，再下手。

steps.title: 直播规则
steps.teach_html:
规则和前几课一样：练习部分（前 27 步）有短文带着，验证部分换新材料自己判断。题目里混着全单元的考点，还有几位老朋友（被动、完成时、unless）在压轴等你。

建议你准备好：每道题先在心里说清“描绘人还是动作、几个对象比较”，再选答案。

steps.title: 先看资料：该不该养狗
steps.teach_html: 下面是今天的辩论短文：李华说 YES，王博说 NO。读的时候把两人的观点和每条理由分开记。短文会留在屏幕上，随时可回看。
steps.reading: Li Hua says YES: 'Dogs are great friends. They love us faithfully and wait for us patiently every day. Keeping a dog also teaches us responsibility. We must feed them, walk them and care for them. In short, dogs make our lives happier.' Wang Bo says NO: 'Dogs can cause many problems. They bark loudly at night and leave hair everywhere. Some dogs even attack people. In addition, keeping a dog costs a lot of money. In short, a dog is not the perfect pet for every family.' Who do you agree with?

steps.title: 说得清楚
steps.scene: 老师说话很清楚，大家都听得见。
steps.stem: The teacher speaks ___ so everyone can hear her.
steps.help: speaks 是动作，配形容词还是副词？
steps.explain: The teacher speaks clearly. clear + ly = clearly，描绘动作。

wrong_feedback.A: clear 是形容词；描绘动词 speaks 用副词 clearly。
wrong_feedback.B: 这里没有比较，不用比较级。
wrong_feedback.D: 没有 clearlyer 这种写法。

steps.reading: Li Hua says YES: 'Dogs are great friends. They love us faithfully and wait for us patiently every day. Keeping a dog also teaches us responsibility. steps.title: 轻轻关门
steps.scene: 宝宝睡着了，他轻轻地关上门。
steps.stem: He closed the door ___ because the baby was asleep. (quiet)
steps.help: closed 是动作；quiet 的副词拼写别写错。
steps.explain: He closed the door quietly. quiet + ly = quietly。

common_errors.say: quiet 是形容词；描绘动作要用副词 quietly。
拼写错位：quietly 的顺序是 q-u-i-e-t-l-y。
副词不加 s。

steps.title: 挑战 · 做得最仔细
steps.scene: 全班同学里她做得最仔细。
steps.stem: She did the work ___ of all the students. (carefully)
steps.help: of all 是范围信号；carefully 的最高级？
steps.explain: She did the work most carefully of all. -ly 副词最高级用 most。

common_errors.say: 那是比较级；有 of all 要用最高级。
没有这种拼法；用 most carefully。
原级不对；全班比较用最高级。

steps.stem: My dog runs ___ than yours.
steps.help: 有 than；fast 怎么变比较级？
steps.explain: My dog runs faster than yours. 两者比较用比较级 faster。

wrong_feedback.A: fast 的比较级加 -er，不用 more。
wrong_feedback.C: 有 than 是两者比较，用比较级；fastest 是最高级。

steps.scene: 考试快到了，他学得比以前努力。
steps.stem: He studies ___ than before because the test is coming.
steps.help: 先看意思对不对，再看形式：hard 和 hardly 选谁？
steps.explain: He studies harder than before. hard 作副词是'努力地'，比较级 harder。

wrong_feedback.A: hardly 是'几乎不'，和'考试快到了要努力'意思相反。
wrong_feedback.C: 有 than 用比较级，不用最高级。

steps.title: 挑战 · 两者用比较级
steps.scene: 陷阱回炉：只有两个男孩。
steps.stem: Of the two boys, Jim writes ___. (carefully)
steps.help: 先数对象：the two boys 是几个？
steps.explain: Of the two boys, Jim writes more carefully. 两者之间用比较级，不能用 most。

common_errors.say: most 是最高级，要三者以上；这里只有两个男孩。
carefully 不能加 -er；比较级用 more carefully。
两者在比，要用比较级。

steps.reading: Li Hua says YES: 'Dogs are great friends. They love us faithfully and wait for us patiently every day. Keeping a dog also teaches us responsibility. steps.title: 对人友善
steps.scene: 这只狗对谁都友善，从不攻击人。
steps.stem: The dog is ___ to everyone. It never attacks people.
steps.help: friendly 的词性在易混点里专门讲过。
steps.explain: The dog is friendly to everyone. friendly 是形容词。

wrong_feedback.B: 没有 friendlily 这种写法；friendly 本身是形容词。
wrong_feedback.C: friend 是名词'朋友'；这里要形容词 friendly。
wrong_feedback.D: friends 是名词复数，不能描绘性情。

steps.reading: Li Hua says YES: 'Dogs are great friends. They love us faithfully and wait for us patiently every day. Keeping a dog also teaches us responsibility. steps.title: 很可能来
steps.scene: 他从不迟到，很可能会来。
steps.stem: It is ___ that he will come. He is never late. (likely)
steps.help: 从不迟到的人，会来是'很可能'还是'不大可能'？
steps.explain: It is likely that he will come. likely = 很可能；unlikely 是它的反义词。

common_errors.say: 意思反了：从不迟到说明'很可能'会来，用 likely。
形容词不加 s。
like 是'喜欢/像'，不是'可能'；要用 likely。

steps.scene: 读辩论短文李华的话。
steps.stem: Li Hua says dogs love us ___.
steps.help: love 是动作；faithful 变副词加什么？
steps.explain: Dogs love us faithfully. faithful + ly = faithfully。

wrong_feedback.A: faithful 是形容词；描绘动词 love 要用副词 faithfully。
wrong_feedback.C: faith 是名词'信任'，不能描绘动作。
wrong_feedback.D: 没有这种比较级写法，这里也没有比较。

steps.title: 挑战 · 攻击人
steps.scene: 王博的论据之一：有些狗会攻击人。
steps.stem: Wang Bo says some dogs even ___ people. (attack)
steps.help: 主语 some dogs 是复数；句子转述的是一般情况。
steps.explain: Some dogs even attack people. 主语复数，一般现在时动词用原形 attack。

common_errors.say: 主语是复数 dogs，动词不能加 s。
转述的是一般情况，用一般现在时，不用过去式。
attacking 前面要有 be 动词，这里没有。

steps.title: 总之

steps.help: 总结时用的固定短语，课本短语表里的。
steps.explain: In short, I think dogs are great pets. in short = 总之。

wrong_feedback.A: shortly 是'不久'；总结收尾的短语是 In short。
wrong_feedback.B: 没有 in a short 这个短语；固定说法是 in short。
wrong_feedback.D: 词序反了：先 in 再 short。

责任是 responsibility，拼写有点像，别混。

steps.help: 时间词 last week 决定时态。
steps.explain: The vet advised us to walk the dog more. advise 的过去式是 advised。

wrong_feedback.B: last week 是过去，要用过去式 advised。
wrong_feedback.C: advice 是名词；这里需要动词。
wrong_feedback.D: 讲的是上周的事，不能用现在时 advises。

steps.title: 挑战 · 狗被遛
steps.scene: 回锅被动：狗每天被主人遛。
steps.stem: The dog ___ by its owner every day. (walk)
steps.help: 狗是被遛的对象；every day 是一般现在时。
steps.explain: The dog is walked by its owner every day. 被动语态：is + walked。

common_errors.say: walks 是主动（狗自己遛？）；狗是被遛的，要用被动。
被动要用过去分词 walked，不是原形。
少了 is：被动结构要完整。

介词错了：'照顾'是 care for。

steps.title: 新任务：给新主人的信
steps.teach_html: 换材料了：宠物俱乐部写给新任狗主人的一封信，里面全是实在的建议。这次自己判断，还要注意信里 firstly/secondly 这样的结构词。短文会留在屏幕上。
steps.reading: Dear new dog owners, welcome! First, walk your dog every morning and evening. A dog that runs freely in the park sleeps most quietly at night. Second, feed it carefully and take it to the vet if it gets ill. Third, train it patiently — a well-trained dog hardly ever causes trouble. If you do these things, your dog will grow up happily and healthily. — From the Pet Club

steps.title: 第一件事
steps.scene: 读信回答：信里让新主人做的第一件事是什么？
steps.stem: What is the first thing the letter tells new owners to do?
options: Walk their dogs every morning and evening.
Take their dogs to the vet every day.
steps.help: 找 First 后面的那一句。
steps.explain: Walk their dogs every morning and evening. 信里 First 后面就是遛狗这件事。

wrong_feedback.B: 喂食是第二条（Second），题目问的是第一件。
wrong_feedback.C: 信里说生病时才去看兽医，不是每天都去。
wrong_feedback.D: 信里没说夜里训练；训练是第三条，而且没提时间。

steps.reading: Dear new dog owners, welcome! First, walk your dog every morning and evening. A dog that runs freely in the park sleeps most quietly at night. Second, feed it carefully and take it to the vet if it gets ill. Third, train it patiently — a well-trained dog hardly ever causes trouble. If you do these things, your dog will grow up happily and healthily. — From the Pet Club

steps.title: 挑战 · 睡得最安静
steps.scene: 运动够了的狗夜里睡得最安静。
steps.stem: Of all the pets, a dog that runs freely sleeps ___ at night. (quietly)
steps.help: of all 是范围；quietly 的最高级？
steps.explain: A dog that runs freely sleeps most quietly at night. -ly 副词最高级用 most。

common_errors.say: 那是比较级；of all 要用最高级。
没有这种拼法；用 most quietly。
原级不对；有范围比较要用最高级。

harder 是比较级，这里没有比较。

steps.title: 挑战 · 哪句对
steps.scene: 全单元综合：只有一句全对。
steps.stem: Which sentence is right?
options: She did her homework carefullier than her brother.
She did her homework more careful than her brother.
She does her homework more carefully than her brother yesterday.
She did her homework more carefully than her brother.
steps.help: 逐句查四点：变法、选词、时态、描绘对象。
steps.explain: She did her homework more carefully than her brother. 四处都对。

wrong_feedback.A: -ly 副词的比较级用 more，不能加 -er。

wrong_feedback.C: yesterday 是过去时间，动词要用 did，不能用 does。

common_errors.say: 那是比较级；of all 要用最高级。

原级不对；有范围比较要用最高级。

common_errors.say: 短语里 addition 不加 s。
additional 是形容词；短语里用名词 addition。
多了 to；单独使用时后面直接跟句子。

common_errors.say: 作结构词（连接句子的）要用 Secondly；Second 多作形容词'第二的'。
没有这种写法，不加 s。

Keeping a dog costs a lot of money.

steps.title: 挑战 · 养了多年
steps.scene: 回锅完成时：我从它小时候就养着它。
steps.stem: I ___ this dog since it was a puppy. (keep)
steps.help: since + 过去的时间点，是现在完成时的信号。
steps.explain: I have kept this dog since it was a puppy. 现在完成时：have + 过去分词 kept。

common_errors.say: 主语是 I 不能用 keeps；而且有 since，要用完成时。
只有 kept 是一般过去时；since 要求 have kept。
have 后面要用过去分词 kept，不是原形。

steps.explain: The little dog waited patiently. patient + ly = patiently。

common_errors.say: patient 是形容词；描绘动作 waited 用副词 patiently。
副词不加 s。

steps.title: 挑战 · 除非有时间
steps.scene: 收官产出：除非你有时间，否则养不好狗。
steps.stem: You cannot keep a dog well ___ you have time for it. (unless)
steps.help: 先想意思：有时间才能养好——空里是 if 还是 unless？
steps.explain: You cannot keep a dog well unless you have time for it. unless = if...not。

common_errors.say: 意思反了：if you have time 是'如果有时间'，和前半句'养不好'接不上；unless 才对。
拼写：unless 词尾两个 s 已经够了。
这个空用 unless 最合适；if not 需要重新组句。

steps.title: 挑战预告：毕业压轴
steps.teach_html: 最后五道是全单元的毕业压轴：最高级、比较级产出、被动语态、事实与观点辨析、辩论写作收尾句。把这一单元的功夫全亮出来。

steps.title: 挑战 · 哪句对
steps.scene: 毕业题：只有一句全对。
steps.stem: Which sentence is right?
options: Of all the boys, he speaks English better.
Of all the boys, he speaks English wellest.
Of all the boys, he speak English best.
Of all the boys, he speaks English best.
steps.help: 逐句查：最高级形式、三单。
steps.explain: Of all the boys, he speaks English best. 形式和三单都对。

wrong_feedback.A: of all 用最高级 best，不用比较级 better。
wrong_feedback.B: 没有 wellest 这个词；well 的最高级是 best。
wrong_feedback.C: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，动词要加 s：speaks。

steps.title: 挑战 · 学说话更快
steps.scene: 鹦鹉学说话比狗快。
steps.stem: Dogs learn fast, but parrots learn to speak ___ than dogs. (fast)
steps.help: 有 than；fast 的比较级？
steps.explain: Parrots learn to speak faster than dogs. 两者比较用比较级 faster。

common_errors.say: fast 的比较级加 -er，不用 more。
有 than 用比较级；fastest 是最高级。
有 than 必须用比较级。

steps.title: 挑战 · 被善待
steps.scene: 毕业题：被动语态收官。
steps.stem: The street dogs ___ kindly by the people in this town. (treat)
steps.help: 街上的狗是被人们善待的；主语是复数。
steps.explain: The street dogs are treated kindly by the people. 被动语态：复数用 are + 过去分词 treated。注意 kindly 也是副词。

common_errors.say: treat 是主动；狗是被对待的对象，要用被动。
被动要用过去分词 treated，不是原形。
主语 dogs 是复数，be 动词用 are。

steps.title: 挑战 · 事实还是观点
steps.scene: 课本同款题型：哪一句是观点（opinion），不是事实？
steps.stem: Which sentence is an opinion, not a fact?
options: Dogs are the best pets in the world.
A dog sleeps about ten hours a day.
steps.help: 观点是个人看法，常有 best、I think 这类信号；事实能验证。
steps.explain: Dogs are the best pets in the world. 这是个人观点（opinion）；其余三句都是可验证的事实。

wrong_feedback.B: 这是能验证的事实（fact），不是观点。
wrong_feedback.C: 这是可以观察到的事实。
wrong_feedback.D: 这是数据型的事实陈述，可以查证。

steps.title: 挑战 · 写作收尾
steps.scene: 辩论文的收尾句：总之，我相信狗让生活更美好。
steps.stem: In ___, I believe dogs make our lives better. (short)
steps.help: 收尾短语 in ___：里面是哪个词？
steps.explain: In short, I believe dogs make our lives better. in short 是收尾总结的固定短语。

common_errors.say: shortly 是'不久'；收尾短语是 in short。
shorts 是'短裤'，意思全错了。
没有这种用法；记住 in short 两个词就够。

steps.title: 收官：把这一单元带走
steps.teach_html:
Unit 8 全部结束。盘点一下你的收获：副词的构成和位置、比较级和最高级、19 个新词加 9 个短语，还有辩论文的读法——找观点、分论据、辨事实与观点。

站长最后一句：学英语和养宠物一样，靠的是每天一点耐心——train yourself patiently, and you will speak better and better. 下一站见！
